data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger integration phase with FY26E showing legacy merger impact (11.9% loan growth, 34% CASA). Recovery trajectory from FY27E onwards as: (1) Loan growth accelerates to 13.5-14.5% as retail lending normalizes and corporate credit demand improves with capex cycle; (2) NIM expands 30-50bps to 3.5% driven by CASA ratio improvement from current 34% to 41% by FY30E as merged book stabilizes and franchise strength reasserts; (3) Credit costs normalize from current elevated 1.24% to sub-1% as asset quality improves with GNPA expected below 1%; (4) Operating leverage improves with cost-to-income declining to 36% through scale benefits and digital initiatives; (5) ROA expands from 1.92% to 2.25% and ROE from 13.9% to 16.5% reflecting superior profitability metrics returning to pre-merger trajectory; Strong capital position (CAR 19.9%) supports growth without dilution. Conservative assumptions given India GDP growth 6-7%, credit growth 12-15% environment, and HDFC's market leadership position.
